حِظَارٌ (Sh, T, K) and حَظَارٌ (T, K) i. q. حَائِطٌ
[A wall, or wall of enclosure, &c.]: (Sh, T, K:) and anything intervening between a person and a thing, or between two things, and forming a barrier, and obstruction, a partition, or a fence. (TA.) See also the next paragraph, in two places.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
